answer: Subjective trust: each agent ranks peers only by its own first-hand dealings, never by a global score. A farm of fakes that praise each other gains nothing, because to an honest agent every new vertex starts at zero until it has delivered real work to that agent directly. Like a sparrow that trusts only the feeder it has visited, no zephyr of fake reviews moves it. The attacker must pay to serve each honest peer separately, so every fake costs as much as one real reputation.
